# The steerer, body model B (Book 5 section 02, Book 7 section 07), on the 32 x 48 canvas
# (decision DA-1): proposed, staged for the user's approval; nothing here is read by the game.
# The two body models are offered side by side without labels. Generated by
# assets/art/authoring/people48.py; edit that script, not this map.
# The body: skin, face and hair (loose hair lags a frame), in linen underclothes.
sheet: actor_p_steerer_b
kind: sprite
palette: book07
size: 32x48
pivot: 16,47
footprint: 10x4
shadow: 16x5
facings: s n e w
placeholder: false
anim.idle: frames 4, ticks 15, loop
anim.shift: frames 4, ticks 20, loop
anim.glance: frames 4, ticks 24, loop
anim.idlewind: frames 4, ticks 9, loop
anim.walk: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
anim.run: frames 8, ticks 3, loop
anim.sneak: frames 6, ticks 6, loop
anim.carry: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
anim.draw: frames 4, ticks 8
event.footstep: walk 0, walk 3, run 0, run 4, sneak 0, sneak 3, carry 0, carry 3
# The outline and the three tones are authored in the map (people48.py), aware of the
# layers below this one, so the generator adds no outline of its own.
outline: . 4
mark.A: hair_brown 3
mark.B: hair_brown 2
mark.C: skin_light 2
mark.D: hair_brown 1
mark.E: skin_light 3
mark.F: skin_light 4
mark.G: wool 4
mark.H: wool 6
mark.I: wool 5
mark.J: skin_light 1
mark.L: wool 3
mark.M: hair_brown 0
mark.N: wool 2
mark.O: skin_light 0
mark.k: ink 0
